answer_1.quote: We study the behavior of LLMs with constituent movement in English. We model Heavy NP Shift (HNPS), Dative Alternation (DA), Particle Movement (PM), Multiple PP Shift (MPP)-see Figure -as a function of its weight.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates and evaluates shifted and unshifted sentence variants to study constituent ordering preferences in LLMs.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a crowdsourced study through Prolific, collecting judgments from 126 native English speakers residing in Anglophone countries, on 500 sentence pairs.
answer_4.guideline: Each participant is presented 25 sentence pairs and asked to judge how natural they sound in relation to each other, assigning a score between 1 and 7; 1 corresponds to the first sentence presented appearing far more natural than the second, and 7 the reverse.
